entries.source:
Mist floated in the pass.
	"This road branches a little further on," @4 said. "To the west it leads towards Loriel and LaMut. To the south, it leads towards Eggley and eventually Krondor. Which way do you think we should take?"�
entries.translation:
濃霧瀰漫山道之間。
	「再往前一段路，這條路便會分岔，」@4說。「往西通往洛瑞爾與拉姆特，往南則通往艾格利，最終抵達克朗多。你們認為我們該走哪條路？」�

entries.source:
Days passed.
	Disliking the exposed feeling created by the defile, they moved quickly during the nights and left the days to resting under rocky overhangs and listening for assassin's footsteps. At last, footsore and road weary, they emerged near the town of Hawk's Hollow.�
entries.translation:
數日過去。
	他們不喜隘道帶來的暴露感，於是趁夜疾行，白天則躲在岩壁下歇息，豎耳戒備刺客的腳步聲。終於，一行人腳痠腿疼、風塵僕僕，來到了鷹谷鎮附近。�

entries.source:
The trip was ódull.
	With only the occasional cold draft to chill their bones as they moved through the pass, it was a relief to finally feel the more temperate winds typical to the southern reaches of the Kingdom.�
entries.translation:
這趟旅程ó枯燥乏味。
	穿越山道時，偶爾襲來的寒風凍得他們骨頭發疼，直到終於感受到王國南方特有的溫和暖風，才鬆了口氣。�

entries.source:
They turned back.
	In a few moments they were back on the main road.�
entries.translation:
他們轉身折返。
	不消片刻，便回到了大路上。�

	"This road branches a little further on," @4 said. "To the west it leads towards Eggley and eventually Krondor. To the east, it will take us near Sethanon. Which way do you think we should take?"�
entries.translation:
濃霧瀰漫山道之間。
	「再往前一段路，這條路便會分岔，」@4說。「往西通往艾格利，最終抵達克朗多；往東則會帶我們接近賽瑟儂。你們認為我們該走哪條路？」�

entries.source:
The trip was ódull.
	With only the occasional cold draft to chill their bones as they moved through the pass, it was a relief to finally feel the more temperate winds typical to the southern reaches of the Kingdom...�
entries.translation:
這趟旅程ó枯燥乏味。
	穿越山道時，偶爾襲來的寒風凍得他們骨頭發疼，直到終於感受到王國南方特有的溫和暖風，才鬆了口氣…�

entries.source:
The landscape flattened.
	Slowly the hills and trees began to thin, becoming far more sparse in the grassy midlands of the Kingdom...�
entries.translation:
地勢漸趨平坦。
	丘陵與林木逐漸稀疏，眼前是王國中部一望無際的草原…�

entries.source:
They turned back.
	In a few moments they were back on the main road.�
entries.translation:
他們轉身折返。
	不消片刻，便回到了大路上。�

entries.source: Beware! Dangerous forest!�
entries.translation: 小心！危險森林！�

entries.source:
Marlen Shephard
"Threw a stone at a dragon."�
entries.translation:
馬倫．謝帕德
「朝巨龍扔了顆石頭。」�

entries.source:
Raoul du Lezanne
"Skins were his trade."�
entries.translation:
拉伍爾．杜勒贊
「他以獸皮為業。」�

entries.source:
Jarrett Jester
"Stood beneath the wrong tree."�
entries.translation:
賈瑞特．傑斯特
「站錯了樹下。」�

entries.source:
Forrest Walker
"Deadicated"�
entries.translation:
佛瑞斯特．沃克
「至死不渝。」�

entries.source:
Christopher Madine
"He was like a brother to us."�
entries.translation:
克里斯多福．馬岱恩
「他待我們如同兄弟。」�

entries.source:
James Delittle
"Swallowed his pride and it killed him."�
entries.translation:
詹姆士．德利托
「吞下了自尊心，卻要了他的命。」�

entries.source:
Dell Briddle
"She followed her love wherever he went."�
entries.translation:
戴爾．布里朵
「無論他去哪裡，她都追隨相伴。」�

entries.source:
Unknown
"May his soul find the peace he could not."�
entries.translation:
無名氏
「願他的靈魂，尋得生前未曾擁有的安寧。」�

entries.source:
Red du Wied
"A stronger man there never was."�
entries.translation:
雷德．杜維德
「世上再無比他更堅強之人。」�

entries.source:
Julie DeChamp
"Her smile could warm the coldest day."�
entries.translation:
茱莉．德香
「她的微笑，能溫暖最寒冷的日子。」�

entries.source:
Paulson Berthold
"Came to the Dimwood looking for peace."�
entries.translation:
波爾森．伯托德
「來到幽暗林，只為尋一份安寧。」�

entries.source:
Barlew Tunns
"He forgot to concentrate."�
entries.translation:
巴爾魯．唐斯
「他忘了集中精神。」�

entries.source:
Ashlyn Mecchus
"All who knew her loved her."�
entries.translation:
艾希琳．梅丘斯
「所有認識她的人，都深愛著她。」�

entries.source:
Mitchell Janns
"Disappeared into the woods. Never came back."�
entries.translation:
米切爾．揚斯
「消失在林中，再也沒有回來。」�

entries.source:
Miller Dubbs
"At last he has joined his beloved wife."�
entries.translation:
米勒．達布斯
「終於，他與摯愛的妻子重聚了。」�

entries.source:
Rose Dubbs
"No wife shall be so missed."�
entries.translation:
蘿絲．達布斯
「再無妻子如此令人思念。」�

entries.source:
Orson du Bas Fadamor
"Killed the giant that dealt his fatal blow."�
entries.translation:
奧森．杜巴斯．法達莫爾
「殺死了給他致命一擊的巨人。」�
